questions.stem: Which one of the following statements regarding Inflammatory Bowel Disease is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Rectum is always involved in Crohn's disease

options.label: B
options.text: Fistula formation is common in Ulcerative Colitis.

options.label: C
options.text: Stricture formation is common in Ulcerative Colitis.

options.label: D
options.text: Perianal disease is common in Crohn's disease.
